platforms.name: Mobile (Client App)
platforms.detailedDescription: React Native CLI (Bare Workflow) app for the company's clients. Allows users to request scrap bucket exchanges, sign digital contracts, and track collections in real-time on interactive maps showing the truck's exact location.
learnings: Implemented custom maps and routing using react-native-maps and geocoding.
Built robust state management with Redux (Ducks pattern) and Redux-Saga.
Managed native configurations for location permissions and OneSignal push notifications.

platforms.name: Mobile (Driver App)
platforms.detailedDescription: Internal React Native CLI app for truck drivers running a trip state machine. The technical highlight was integrating the Google Directions API with a custom trigonometric calculation to dynamically rotate the truck icon on the map based on real-time GPS coordinates.
learnings: Applied advanced trigonometry to dynamically rotate UI map elements based on GPS displacement vectors.
Synchronized trip state machines with background geolocation updates.
Integrated external navigation apps via react-native-map-link.

platforms.name: Web (Admin Panel)
platforms.detailedDescription: React.js back-office panel to manage the entire ecosystem, handling collection requests and fleet tracking via react-google-maps. It uses client-side Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to segment administrative and logistics modules.
learnings: Built a web architecture sharing the same Redux and Redux-Saga patterns (Ducks) as the mobile apps.
Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for route and component gatekeeping.
Containerized the frontend using Docker multi-stage builds and Nginx.
